Welcome from our Headteacher
'Be courageous; Be strong; Do everything in love'. (1 Corinthians 16: 13-14)
It is my pleasure to be the headteacher of Kidmore End CE Primary School. Kidmore End is a happy, learning-filled primary school, where every individual is valued and can flourish.
Kidmore End School first opened its doors in 1856 to eight pupils. We have grown over the years and we now accommodate up to 210 pupils in seven classes. In August 2017, we became an academy as part of the Oxford Diocesan Schools Trust (ODST).
We would be delighted to welcome visitors to our wonderful village school so that you can come and experience our lovely school community, visit our beautiful grounds, and to help you in your decision to bring your child to join us. Please telephone or email the school office to arrange an appointment.
Miss Claire Spankie, Headteacher

What a wonderful first day back we have had! The pupils were excited to taste the new school lunch offering today, lovingly made and prepared by our new school cook Lisa and her assistant Isobel. pageCache.pageTitle: Kidmore End CE Primary School - Wraparound Care
pageCache.text:
Wraparound Care
Breakfast Club
Breakfast Club is run by Lucy McAdden and her team from Chalkhouse Childcare and is based in the Learning Zone, running every morning during term time (excluding INSET Days) from 7.30am until School starts at 8.35am.
In preparation for the busy school day, Breakfast Club focuses on providing a calm relaxing environment for your children before they head off to their classes. The children are provided with breakfast on arrival and can choose from a range of activities.
The cost per child of a pre-booked place is £6.50. Siblings receive a discount.
To book please email breakfastclub@kidmore-end.co.uk or call Lucy on 07917 931 882.
Please find at the bottom of this page Breakfast Club's Brochure & Safeguarding Policy for your information.
After School Club
After School Club is run by the school from Monday to Thursday until 6pm and is based in the School Hall. It is open every day school is open, with the exception of the last day of our Autumn, Spring & Summer terms, when School is open but After School Club is not.
The cost per child of a pre-booked place is £6 (for a short session until 4.15pm). Alternatively a long session until 6pm, which includes a tea such as pizza at 4.30pm, can be booked. The cost of this long session is £13 per child.
Bookings are made via MCAS. Parents can view availability and select sessions to book.
Parent guides covering how to book a club using MCAS can be found on our MCAS help page.
Sessions are released in half-term blocks approximately one month before each half-term commences. For example, Autumn Term 1 sessions have been released and Autumn Term 2 sessions will be released around 1st October 2026.
Bookings close on MCAS 3 days prior to the session commencing. If you miss the cut-off and wish to make a late booking there is an additional £2 charge. Late bookings are not encouraged but will be accepted if we have space, please email asc@kidmore-end.co.uk to book.
If you need to book a later collection time (ie increase a short session to a long session) on any given date. Please check availability using the app, then email asc@kidmore-end.co.uk to request a credit for your booked short session, either:
(a) after you have secured the long session on the same night via MCAS (this method is recommended if you require immediate confirmation your childcare needs have been met and are happy to receive credits to your account), OR
(b) before you secure your long session (so your credit can be offset against the cost of your long session thereby minimising credits on your account. Please allow 3 working days for your credit to appear on MCAS)
Childcare vouchers or the government tax-free childcare scheme are both accepted methods of payment.
Please allow two weeks for any funds you request from your provider, to be credited to your MCAS account. On receipt, your funds will be visible in the cost/balance column of your MCAS dashboard (within the after school club module) and will be available to use against the cost of future bookings.
In light of the fact credits to your MCAS account have no expiry date, you may find it helpful to keep your MCAS account in credit so you have sufficient funds for any ah hoc dates you require throughout the term.
To gain access to our MCAS booking system, please ensure you return our ASC Contract (LINK).
If your child has not attended our setting before, please find below the registration form we require ahead of their first session commencing:
Please find below After School Club's Brochure, Admissions & Fees policy and Missing, Lost & Uncollected Child Policy for your information. Please read these documents before registering your child.

pageCache.pageTitle: Kidmore End CE Primary School - Open Days
pageCache.text:
Open Days
Open Mornings / Afternoons are held each term on weekdays and last approximately an hour and a half. We aim for an informal occasion where visitors have an opportunity to look around the school, meet with our Headteacher, Miss Spankie, and get a real sense of what we have to offer at Kidmore End Primary.
Booking is essential. If you would like to attend, please register here.
Our Open Days below are aimed at those families wishing to join us in September 2027 and beyond.
If your child has already started school and you are looking to change their school (we call this an in-year admission); or you are interested in joining our 2026 Foundation Stage class in September 2026, we would be more than happy to arrange a tour for you to view our school. Please complete the relevant enquiry form below and someone from our admissions team will be in touch shortly:

Our Governors
At Kidmore End, there are four types of Governors:
Foundation Governors – these are Governors who are appointed by the Diocese;
Co-opted/Community Governors – these are Governors who are elected by other members of the Governing Body and have skills which are of particular interest;
Parent Governors – elected by parents of children attending Kidmore End;
Staff Governors – elected by the staff and include teachers, support staff and our headteacher.
